headline: Base Lines Shift on Central Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Linn Mercy has become the sharpest immediate flashpoint, rising from 24 to 34 strategic-base events in twenty-four hours and recording eight in the latest two; its ledger now stands at ten Colonial bases and one neutral, rather than the earlier eight and three. Palantine Berm remains the busiest sector overall with 61 daily events, though its latest two-hour count has eased to four, while the balance has shifted to three Warden and four Colonial bases. Marban Hollow has cooled from 35 daily events and eight recent to 31 and four, retaining two Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral holdings. Weathered Expanse has 31 daily events and five recent, with its Colonial holding gone and neutral ground increased to three. Gutter remains active at eight daily events and three recent, while Nevish Line records eleven daily events and three recent. Elsewhere, many fronts show little or no base movement despite scattered casualty activity. The war remains undecided, with no faction at the 34-town victory requirement.
